pages.title: What are the Ruins?
pages.text: The Ruins is a dimension that blurs the line between physical and immaterial, between phenomenon and metaphor.$(br2)It gathers forgotten memories, echoes of emotion, departed spirits, and other immateria produced by the other worlds.
Each area of the Ruins is shaped by an emotion.

Practitioners sometimes use the Ruins to cross great distances quickly; its scale is warped similarly to the Nether and it is linked to every other dimension.$(br2)Sometimes we visit with the goal of collecting the souls of slain mobs, which inevitably make their way to this realm.$(br2)Sometimes we even make our homes in this strange place.

Claiming your Demesne in a Ruins biome or taking a biome's corresponding typhlotic beast as Familiar will make that biome more friendly towards you, and defang its natural hazards.$(br2)$(italic)DEV NOTE: The Ruins are still in development. What is in this book has been implemented, but echoes and Hosting are not yet present.
